explication: Macro is a unified team-workspace product spanning email, messaging, documents, tasks, databases, CRM, calls, files, and agents. A typical user works across linked workspace surfaces; agents can use shared team memory and tools to answer questions or take actions. The repository is a broad monorepo, but the supplied excerpts support only selected runtime relationships, so unsampled feature links are documented as capabilities without speculative wiring.
